Exercise: Bench Sprint

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_jump

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- enhance_leg_muscle_coordination
- improve_explosive_power

Contraindications:

- Recent lower body injury
- Severe joint pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Bench Sprint with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball

Substitution Options:

- name: Box Jump, force: push, level: beginner

Instructions:

- Stand on the ground with one foot resting on a bench or box with your heel close to the edge.
- Push off with your foot on top of the bench, extending through the hip and knee.
- Land with the opposite foot on top of the box, returning your other foot back to the start position.
- Continue alternating from one foot to another to complete the set.
